Adding plans enables you to compare the formulary status of a drug to other medications within the same therapeutic class. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. By adding plans, you gain the ability to perform specific comparisons and analyses. The information provided above is intended solely for general informational and educational purposes. Please note that individual plans may differ, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly. By proceeding with the send action, you acknowledge that you are authorized to share this information with the recipient via email.
